sections.title: Before booking in Ann Arbor
sections.html:
Bring a small number of questions, not your entire closet. Ask the consultant to show why one neutral works better for your intended look and how to pair it with an accent. Find out how to use the take-home swatch with printed fabrics and what the booklet explains. Leave time to write down the combinations you would actually repeat.

  • What does the booklet explain beyond my season name?
  • What happens to the deposit if I need to change the appointment?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: After the visit, make a three-outfit test from existing clothes. Keep the silhouettes familiar and change only one color at a time. That makes it easier to decide whether the advice helps rather than attributing every difference to the season label. A phone palette can stay available during shopping, while the physical swatch can help you compare the cloth itself.
